text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: On the first day of the first month you shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.
text_cn: “正月初一，你要竖立会幕的帐棚。

text_en: You shall put in it the ark of the covenant, and you shall screen the ark with the curtain.
text_cn: 把约柜安放在里面，用帷幔将约柜遮起。

text_en: You shall bring in the table, and arrange its setting; and you shall bring in the lampstand, and set up its lamps.
text_cn: 把供桌搬进，摆上当供之物；把灯台搬进，安放上灯盏。

text_en: You shall put the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and set up the screen for the entrance of the tabernacle.
text_cn: 把焚香的金坛安放在约柜前边，悬上帐棚的门帘。

text_en: You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting,
text_cn: 把全燔祭坛安置在会幕门口，

text_en: and place the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
text_cn: 把盆安置在会幕和祭坛之中，盆里放上水。

text_en: You shall set up the court all around, and hang up the screen for the gate of the court.
text_cn: 随后竖立庭院四周的帷幔，悬上庭院的门帘。

text_en: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and consecrate it and all its furniture, so that it shall become holy.
text_cn: 以后拿傅礼的油，给帐棚和其中的一切器具傅油，祝圣帐棚和其中的一切器具，使之成为圣物：

text_en: You shall also anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and consecrate the altar, so that the altar shall be most holy.
text_cn: 即给全燔祭坛及其一切用具傅油，祝圣祭坛，使之成为至圣的；

text_en: You shall also anoint the basin with its stand, and consecrate it.
text_cn: 给盆和盆座傅油，使之成圣。

text_en: Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and shall wash them with water,
text_cn: 以后叫亚郎和他的儿子们来近会幕门口，用水洗他们。

text_en: and put on Aaron the sacred vestments, and you shall anoint him and consecrate him, so that he may serve me as priest.
text_cn: 给亚郎穿上圣衣，给他傅油，祝圣他作我的司祭。

text_en: You shall bring his sons also and put tunics on them,
text_cn: 再叫他的儿子们前来，给他们穿上长衣，

text_en: and anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may serve me as priests: and their anointing shall admit them to a perpetual priesthood throughout all generations to come.
text_cn: 像给他们的父亲傅油一样，也给他们傅油，叫他们作我的司祭。给他们行傅油礼，表示他们世世代代，永远尽司祭之职。”

text_en: Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him.
text_cn: 梅瑟奉行了一切；上主怎样吩咐的，他就怎样作了。

text_en: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was set up.
text_cn: 于是第二年正月初一，帐棚就竖立起来了。

text_en: Moses set up the tabernacle; he laid its bases, and set up its frames, and put in its poles, and raised up its pillars;
text_cn: 梅瑟竖立了帐棚，安上卯（mǎo）座，放上木板，安上横木，竖起柱子。

text_en: and he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent over it; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 将幕顶展开放在帐棚上，将幕顶的罩放在上面，全照上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: He took the covenant and put it into the ark, and put the poles on the ark, and set the mercy seat above the ark;
text_cn: 随后取了约版放在柜内，柜旁穿上杠杆，将赎罪盖安在约柜上面。

text_en: and he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the curtain for screening, and screened the ark of the covenant; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 将柜抬到帐棚内，悬上帐幔，遮住约柜，如上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: He put the table in the tent of meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the curtain,
text_cn: 以后把供桌放在会幕内，放在帐棚北面，帐幔以外；

text_en: and set the bread in order on it before the Lord ; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 在桌上于上主前摆上供饼，如上主吩咐梅瑟的。

text_en: He put the lampstand in the tent of meeting, opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle,
text_cn: 把灯台安置在会幕内，对着供桌，在帐棚南面。

text_en: and set up the lamps before the Lord ; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 在上主前放上灯盏，如上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: He put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the curtain,
text_cn: 把金祭坛安置在会幕内，帐幔的前边。

text_en: and offered fragrant incense on it; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 在坛上燃烧馨香的香料，如上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: He also put in place the screen for the entrance of the tabernacle.
text_cn: 又悬起帐棚的门帘。

text_en: He set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 将全燔祭台安放在会幕门口，在上面奉献全燔祭和素祭，如上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: He set the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing,
text_cn: 将盆安置在会幕和祭坛之中，盆内放了水，为洗濯（zhuó）之用。

text_en: with which Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet.
text_cn: 梅瑟、亚郎和他的儿子们在盆内洗脚。

text_en: When they went into the tent of meeting, and when they approached the altar, they washed; as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 他们进入会幕或接近祭坛时，必先洗濯（zhuó），如上主向梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: He set up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and put up the screen at the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.
text_cn: 随后在帐棚和祭坛四周，竖起了庭院的帷幔，悬起了庭院的门帘：这样梅瑟完成了所有的工程。

text_en: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
text_cn: 那时云彩遮盖了会幕，上主的荣耀充满了帐棚。

text_en: Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud settled upon it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
text_cn: 梅瑟不能进入会幕，因为云彩停在上面，上主的荣耀充满了帐棚。

text_en: Whenever the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out on each stage of their journey;
text_cn: 在以色列子民整个的行程中，云彩一从帐棚升起，他们就拔营前行；

text_en: but if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out until the day that it was taken up.
text_cn: 云彩若不升起，他们就安营不动，直等云彩升起。

text_en: For the cloud of the Lord was on the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, before the eyes of all the house of Israel at each stage of their journey.
text_cn: 在他们整个行程中，上主的云彩白天停在帐棚上，黑夜在云中有火，以色列全家都能见到。
